description: This file provides logging functionality for the OpenClaw project. It defines logging levels, handles log message formatting, and manages multiple log handlers including system and file logging. It also includes utilities for label parsing and log level settings, and extends existing logging types.

classes.name: OpenClawOSLogHandler
classes.description: A custom log handler that sends logs to the Apple Unified Logging system (os.Logger). It supports custom metadata merging and message rendering.

classes.name: OpenClawFileLogHandler
classes.description: A custom log handler that records logs to a file via DiagnosticsFileLog, with support for metadata and log level filtering.

methods.name: logLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current log level from user defaults.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the log level in user defaults.

methods.name: fileLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if file logging is enabled based on user defaults.

methods.name: bootstrapIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes the logging system if it hasn't been set up yet.

methods.name: makeLabel
methods.description: Constructs a label string from subsystem and category.

methods.name: parseLabel
methods.description: Parses a label string into subsystem and category components.
